title: ME51N - Create Purchase Requisition
summary: Creates a new purchase requisition for requesting goods or services.
content: Use ME51N when the requester needs to create a purchase requisition before approval and ordering.

title: ME52N - Change Purchase Requisition
summary: Modifies an existing purchase requisition before final processing or approval.
content: Use ME52N to update requisition lines, quantities, dates, or account assignments when allowed.

title: ME53N - Display Purchase Requisition
summary: Displays a purchase requisition in read-only mode for review and validation.
content: Use ME53N to inspect requisition details, approval status, and line-item information.

title: ME21N - Create Purchase Order
summary: Creates a purchase order from approved requisition or purchasing data.
content: Use ME21N to create a new purchase order for a vendor or supplier.

title: ME22N - Change Purchase Order
summary: Changes an existing purchase order when updates are permitted.
content: Use ME22N to adjust PO lines, delivery dates, pricing, or vendor data as allowed by policy.

title: ME23N - Display Purchase Order
summary: Displays purchase order details for review without editing.
content: Use ME23N to view PO header data, line items, and status information.

title: ME41 - Create Request for Quotation
summary: Creates a request for quotation to collect supplier pricing and terms.
content: Use ME41 when sourcing requires bids or quotations from suppliers.

title: ME47 - Maintain Quotation
summary: Maintains supplier quotation data in the procurement process.
content: Use ME47 to enter or update quotation responses received from suppliers.

title: ME49 - Compare Quotations
summary: Compares supplier quotations to support award decisions.
content: Use ME49 to compare pricing and terms across supplier quotations.

title: ME11 - Create Info Record
summary: Creates a purchasing info record for vendor and material relationships.
content: Use ME11 to store vendor pricing, lead time, and purchasing data.

title: ME01 - Maintain Source List
summary: Maintains the approved source list for procurement planning.
content: Use ME01 to control which vendors can supply specific materials during the validity period.

title: XK01 - Create Vendor
summary: Creates a vendor master record in classic SAP master data flows.
content: Use XK01 to create a vendor when a new supplier must be entered in the SAP system.

title: XK02 - Change Vendor
summary: Changes existing vendor master data.
content: Use XK02 to update vendor address, payment, or purchasing information when permitted.

title: XK03 - Display Vendor
summary: Displays vendor master data in read-only mode.
content: Use XK03 to review vendor master details without changing records.

title: LT01 - Create Transfer Order
summary: Creates a transfer order for warehouse movement processes.
content: Use LT01 to create a transfer order based on warehouse requirements.

title: LT10 - Create TO for Transfer Requirement
summary: Creates a transfer order from a transfer requirement.
content: Use LT10 when warehouse operations need a transfer order created from a transfer requirement.

title: LT21 - Confirm Transfer Order
summary: Confirms completion of a transfer order in warehouse processing.
content: Use LT21 to confirm that a transfer order has been executed.

title: LX01 - Inventory Count
summary: Supports inventory counting for warehouse or stock processes.
content: Use LX01 when counting inventory in a controlled warehouse process.

title: LXN1 - Display Inventory Difference
summary: Displays inventory differences detected during stock counting or reconciliation.
content: Use LXN1 to review inventory discrepancies and investigate count variances.

title: /SCWM/TO_CREATE - Create Warehouse Task
summary: Creates a warehouse task in SAP Extended Warehouse Management.
content: Use /SCWM/TO_CREATE to create warehouse tasks for EWM execution.

title: /SCWM/PRDO - Process Warehouse Orders
summary: Processes warehouse orders within SAP EWM.
content: Use /SCWM/PRDO to manage or process warehouse orders in EWM.

title: /SCWM/MON - Monitor Warehouse Activities
summary: Monitors warehouse activities and execution status in EWM.
content: Use /SCWM/MON to monitor warehouse operations, queues, and task status.

title: MB1C - Initial Stock Entry
summary: Posts an initial stock entry into inventory.
content: Use MB1C when entering starting stock into the system.

title: MB1A - Goods Issue
summary: Posts a goods issue from inventory.
content: Use MB1A to record stock leaving inventory for consumption or issue.

title: MB1B - Transfer Posting
summary: Posts inventory transfers between stock types or locations.
content: Use MB1B when stock must be moved between inventory categories or locations.

title: MIGO - Goods Movement
summary: All-in-one transaction for goods receipt, goods issue, transfer, and returns.
content: Use MIGO to post most warehouse and inventory movement activities in one place.

title: MB51 - Material Document List
summary: Lists material documents for inventory and logistics review.
content: Use MB51 to inspect posted material documents and movement history.

title: MB52 - Stock Overview by Storage Location
summary: Shows stock levels by storage location.
content: Use MB52 to review inventory by storage location and storage type.

title: MB5T - Stock in Transit
summary: Displays stock currently in transit between locations or plants.
content: Use MB5T to monitor stock that has been shipped but not yet received.

title: VL01N - Create Outbound Delivery
summary: Creates an outbound delivery for shipping and logistics execution.
content: Use VL01N to create outbound deliveries for customer or stock movement processes.

title: VL02N - Change Outbound Delivery
summary: Changes an outbound delivery before completion.
content: Use VL02N to adjust outbound delivery data when allowed.

title: VL03N - Display Outbound Delivery
summary: Displays outbound delivery details without editing.
content: Use VL03N to review outbound delivery status and line items.

title: VL10B - Purchase Orders Due for Delivery
summary: Lists purchase orders due for delivery.
content: Use VL10B to identify purchase orders that are ready for delivery processing.

title: VL31N - Create Inbound Delivery
summary: Creates an inbound delivery for receiving goods.
content: Use VL31N to create inbound deliveries in receiving and logistics flows.

title: VT01N - Create Shipment
summary: Creates a shipment document for logistics planning.
content: Use VT01N to create a shipment in transportation processing.

title: VT02N - Change Shipment
summary: Changes shipment data before completion.
content: Use VT02N to update shipment details when required.

title: VT03N - Display Shipment
summary: Displays shipment data in read-only mode.
content: Use VT03N to inspect shipment information and execution status.

title: MD01 - Create MRP Run
summary: Creates an MRP run for planning and supply analysis.
content: Use MD01 to execute materials requirement planning.

title: MD04 - Display Stock/Requirement List
summary: Displays stock and requirement information for a material.
content: Use MD04 to review open demand, supply, and stock status.

title: MD05 - MRP List
summary: Displays the MRP list for planning review.
content: Use MD05 to inspect MRP results and planning elements.

title: MD06 - Collective MRP Run
summary: Runs collective MRP for multiple materials or plants.
content: Use MD06 to execute planning across a group of materials.

title: MC94 - Forecasting
summary: Supports forecasting for planning and demand analysis.
content: Use MC94 for forecasting and demand planning tasks.

title: /SAPAPO/SNP01 - Supply Network Planning
summary: Runs supply network planning in SAP APO.
content: Use /SAPAPO/SNP01 for supply network planning workflows.

title: /SAPAPO/PPT1 - Product Planning Table
summary: Opens the product planning table in SAP APO.
content: Use /SAPAPO/PPT1 to plan products and review planning data.

title: ME2N - PO List by PO Number
summary: Lists purchase orders by PO number for reporting and tracking.
content: Use ME2N to search and analyze POs by document number.

title: ME80FN - General Analysis of Purchasing Documents
summary: Provides general analysis of purchasing documents.
content: Use ME80FN for broad procurement document analysis and reporting.

title: MC.9 - Material Analysis
summary: Analyzes material-related business data for reporting.
content: Use MC.9 when material analysis is required for planning or reporting.

title: MB5B - Stock on Posting Date
summary: Shows stock as of a specific posting date.
content: Use MB5B for date-based stock checks and historical inventory positions.

title: MB5L - List of Stock Values
summary: Lists stock values for inventory valuation and reporting.
content: Use MB5L to review stock value reports.

title: MCBA - Vendor Performance Evaluation
summary: Evaluates vendor performance for procurement decisions.
content: Use MCBA to review vendor performance metrics and trends.

title: SE16N - Table View
summary: Displays SAP table contents for analysis and troubleshooting.
content: Use SE16N to inspect tables such as EKPO, EKKO, MARC, and other application data tables.

title: SUIM - User Authorization Info
summary: Provides user and authorization analysis tools.
content: Use SUIM to review roles, authorizations, and user access information.

title: ST22 - Dump Analysis
summary: Analyzes ABAP runtime dumps and system errors.
content: Use ST22 to inspect system dumps and investigate runtime failures.

title: SM37 - Job Monitoring
summary: Monitors background jobs in the SAP system.
content: Use SM37 to review scheduled, running, and completed background jobs.

title: MEK1 - Create Condition Records
summary: Creates pricing and condition records for procurement.
content: Use MEK1 to maintain pricing condition records used in purchasing.
